1. Master 3D Architectural Cutaway Plan Orthogonal Top-Down View
Architectural Layout Features Zoning & Circulation
  • Kids' Double-Deck (Bunk) Bed: Vertically sleeps 2 children (1.00m × 2.05m) with safety ladder and upper guardrails.
  • Kids' Multi-Door Wardrobe: Built-in 1.60m × 0.60m full-height wardrobe with hanging space, shelves, and toy bins.
  • Corner Kitchen Storage: L-shaped cabinets in upper-right corner; clean prep countertops (no cooker, no sink, no fridge).
  • Integrated Breakfast Bar: 1.60m dining counter with 4 wooden barstools facing the living room; no separate table needed.
  • Dual-Zone Family Lounge: Back L-shaped sectional couch + front TV sofa (8–10 person capacity).
  • Clear Walkway: Middle chair removed to create a wide 1.80m central passage between entrance and all rooms.
  • Master Bedroom (Left): Queen-size bed (1.60×2.00m), nightstands, and a 2.20m full-height wardrobe.
  • Zero Wasted Space: No interior bathroom; every single square meter is dedicated to active family living.

Iron Sheets (Mabati) & Roof Framing Comparison Analysis Devin's 15 Sheets in Stock
Option 1: Traditional Gable Roof (Dual Pitch)
  • Total Sheets Needed: 24 sheets (12 per pitch).
  • Devin's Deficit to Buy: 9 more sheets (~KES 13,050).
  • Ridge Caps (Marangi): 5 pcs needed (~KES 3,500).
  • Timber Framing: 520 ft rafters + 480 ft purlins (~KES 50,600).
  • Guttering: Dual front & rear gutters (17 meters total).
Option 2: Modern Mono-Pitch (Single Slope — RECOMMENDED)
  • Total Sheets Needed: 20 sheets (Saves 4 full sheets!).
  • Devin's Deficit to Buy: Only 5 more sheets! (~KES 7,250).
  • Ridge Caps (Marangi): 0 pcs needed! (Zero ridge seam leak risk).
  • Timber Framing: 410 ft rafters + 390 ft purlins (Saves KES ~10,300).
  • Guttering: Single rear 8.5m gutter straight to 5,000L tank.
  • NET SAVINGS FOR DEVIN: KES 28,500!
